title: Madalasa–Alarka capability discovery and stepwise permission handoff

screens.title: Welcome to Alarka
screens.implementation_note: Entry only after guardian pairing intent. No sensor access before permission.

screens.title: Checking this device
screens.implementation_note: Read-only PackageManager/CameraManager/SensorManager probes; no false operational claim.

screens.title: Compatibility result
screens.implementation_note: Hardware availability separate from permission state and feature release status.

screens.title: Feature details
screens.implementation_note: Every feature must carry support, permission, availability, release status and observed_at.

screens.title: Secure device pairing
screens.implementation_note: Prohibit unsigned capability ingestion; bind to child and authenticated device.

screens.title: Before permissions
screens.implementation_note: Show purpose, required/optional, retention and who receives data before OS dialog.

screens.title: Location while using
screens.implementation_note: For Android 11+ never request foreground and background location in one request.

screens.title: Background location
screens.implementation_note: Android 11+ background location guided through settings; do not claim active until policy approved.

screens.title: Monitoring notifications
screens.implementation_note: Do not hide icon/system indicators; notification permission denial impacts transparency.

screens.title: Usage access
screens.implementation_note: Use UsageStatsManager permission state via AppOps; Android Settings, OS confirmation.

screens.title: Choose media access
screens.implementation_note: READ_MEDIA_* with selected-photo access; never infer all library files from partial grant.

screens.title: Microphone permission
screens.implementation_note: Do not solicit dangerous permission in commercial build unless released; use demo only.

screens.title: Camera access · Research
screens.implementation_note: Never auto-enable media merely because hardware exists. Demo shown as research-only.

screens.title: Managed-device mode
screens.implementation_note: Real device-owner enrollment may require factory reset; never claim admin equals owner.

screens.title: Screen-sharing consent
screens.implementation_note: Android 14+ per-session MediaProjection token; do not store consent for reuse.

screens.title: Android decision received
screens.implementation_note: ActivityResult then PackageManager/AppOps; never trust button-click or app-owned approval.

screens.title: Permission declined
screens.implementation_note: Handle don't-ask-again/Settings flow without harassment or bypass.

screens.title: Selected photos only
screens.implementation_note: Persist only allowed URI grants; never equate selected media with full library.

screens.title: Permission confirmed
screens.implementation_note: Local OS grant, server durable ACK and parent confirmation are distinct events.

screens.title: Setup complete
screens.implementation_note: Only permitted background components continue; main Alarka Activity need not remain open.

screens.title: Access changed in Settings
screens.implementation_note: Revocation can terminate app process: cannot guarantee immediate callback or push.

screens.title: Re-enable a permission
screens.implementation_note: A regrant updates permission state only; runtime operational and release gates separate.

screens.title: Offline changes queued
screens.implementation_note: No claims of instant revocation propagation; deadlines and monotonic versions.

screens.title: Your monitoring controls
screens.implementation_note: Visible identity and accessible privacy controls even after setup Activity normally closes.

screens.title: Child device connecting
screens.implementation_note: First parent frame before trusted pairing/attestation. No parental spoofed capability.

screens.title: Device overview
screens.implementation_note: Multiple counts should be derived separately, without conflating support/grant/active.

screens.title: Feature compatibility
screens.implementation_note: Never use a single green feature flag for OS grants and runtime eligibility.

screens.title: Setup progress
screens.implementation_note: Server stores versioned state, emits parent update on durable write.

screens.title: Access granted
screens.implementation_note: Do not call all dependent features fully operational based on an OS grant.

screens.title: Permission disabled
screens.implementation_note: Only a device-authenticated report justifies exact revocation claim; stop stream.

screens.title: Denied or unsupported?
screens.implementation_note: Do not suggest bypass for legal feature-off or absent hardware.

screens.title: Temporary access
screens.implementation_note: One-time camera/mic/location grants can terminate; TTL and capture-time check required.

screens.title: Partial media access
screens.implementation_note: No arbitrary filesystem access or inference of selected photo selection list.

screens.title: Remote camera conditions
screens.implementation_note: Permission green but media operational amber / release flag OFF.

screens.title: Screen request approval
screens.implementation_note: No repeated media projection token reuse; do not promise remote activation.

screens.title: Managed-mode requirement
screens.implementation_note: Device Admin access alone does not create device-owner authority.

screens.title: Alarka is offline
screens.implementation_note: No fabricated 'permission revoked' result from stale/offline snapshot.

screens.title: Status needs recheck
screens.implementation_note: Per-feature TTL; stale not green; recheck at command execution.

screens.title: Status restored
screens.implementation_note: Server broadcasts only after durable write and monotonic version validation.

screens.title: Permission change history
screens.implementation_note: Change audit reason/actor/source with limited retention; no raw media or protected data.

screens.title: How to enable location
screens.implementation_note: No parent-side silent permission grant; preserve Android user agency.

screens.title: Guardian access check
screens.implementation_note: Authorization for report reading and permission-related commands must be child-specific.

screens.title: Report version conflict
screens.implementation_note: Monotonic version + compare-and-set; reject duplicates/conflicts and require device-signed source.

screens.title: Privacy switch disabled
screens.implementation_note: Do not override global sensor controls; report exact reason only with actual device evidence.

screens.title: Approval reversed
screens.implementation_note: Revocation may kill process; event can only appear after subsequent authenticated sync.

screens.title: Full compatibility details
screens.implementation_note: Green operational only if supported + proper access + context + release approved + fresh confirmation.
